text.about_md:
**Credentials.** Every call takes a Gandi Personal Access Token, which starts `pat_`.
Create one in the Organizations section of Gandi's admin site (admin.gandi.net). Pass it as
the `apikey` option and the SDK sends it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The base URL
is `https://api.gandi.net/v5`; to work against Gandi's sandbox, which has its own accounts
and tokens, pass `base: 'https://api.sandbox.gandi.net/v5'`. The CLI and the MCP server read
the token from `GANDI_APIKEY`, so an agent's MCP config sets it under `env`:
`"env": { "GANDI_APIKEY": "pat_..." }`.

```ts
import { GandiSDK } from '@voxgig-sdk/gandi-sdk'

const client = new GandiSDK({ apikey: process.env.GANDI_APIKEY ?? '' })

// Your domains.
const domains = await client.Domain().list()
for (const domain of domains) {
  console.log(domain.data().fqdn)
}

// The DNS records of one of them, on LiveDNS.
const records = await client.LivednsRecord().list({ fqdn: 'example.com' })
console.log(records.length)

// A new A record for www.
await client.LivednsRecord().create({
  fqdn: 'example.com',
  rrset_name: 'www',
  rrset_type: 'A',
  rrset_ttl: 300,
  rrset_values: ['192.0.2.1'],
})
```

**Names.** A domain is named by its `fqdn` throughout: `Domain().load({ fqdn })`,
`LivednsDomain().load({ fqdn })`. The resources below a domain at the registry take
Gandi's own `domain` parameter, as in `DomainHost().list({ domain })`. A DNS record is
named by `fqdn`, `rrset_name` and `rrset_type`, a mailbox by its `address`.

**Actions.** A verb on a resource is an action, selected with `$action` in the request data.
Resetting a domain's authorization code is `$action: 'authinfo'` on a `Domain` update, and
`autorenew`, `status` (the transfer lock), `reachability`, `renew`, `restore` and
`transferout` work the same way. An operation on a whole collection is never chosen by leaving
a parameter out: every record of one name is `$action: 'name'` on `LivednsRecord`, renewing
every mailbox of a domain in the Email API is `$action: 'renew_all'`, and replacing or deleting
every record of a zone is `LivednsZone().update()` or `.remove()`, an entity of its own.
An operation that is only an action needs the action too: checking a mail domain's DNS is
`MailboxDomain().create({ domain, $action: 'validate' })`, and the same call without
`$action` is refused rather than sent.

**Scope.** Every one of the 221 operations in the twelve sections of Gandi's v5 documentation
is here, as 61 entities named after Gandi's own resources. The Email API, which Gandi marks
deprecated, is included as `Email*`; its replacement is `Mailbox*`. Some operations cost
money (registering, renewing or transferring a domain, buying a mailbox or a certificate), as
Gandi's documentation warns. For what each field means, follow the links to Gandi's
documentation.

**Not yet run against Gandi.** Gandi publishes no OpenAPI definition, so this SDK's was
constructed from Gandi's API documentation (`.sdk/def/README.md`). Every example in that
documentation was checked against it, but no request has yet been sent to Gandi's API.

entity_desc.access_token: Renew the Personal Access Token the call is made with.
entity_desc.acme_account: The ACME accounts of a subscription: list them or get one.
entity_desc.acme_domain: The domains of an ACME subscription: list them or get one.
entity_desc.acme_price: ACME catalog prices, and a quote for a list of domains (create).
entity_desc.acme_subscription: An ACME subscription: list, create, get, rename or delete one, or change its domains (`domains`).
entity_desc.billing_info: Billing information: prepaid balance and price grid, for your account or an organization.
entity_desc.billing_price: Catalog prices for one product type.
entity_desc.certificate_dcv: A certificate's domain control validation: resend it (update) or change its method (patch).
entity_desc.certificate_package: The certificate packages on offer: list them or get one.
entity_desc.certificate_pem: An intermediate certificate, as PEM text, by type or by file name.
entity_desc.certificate_tag: A certificate's tags: list, add, replace, change or remove them.
entity_desc.comment: The comment on a Gandi product, by the product id: get, set or delete it.
entity_desc.domain: A registered domain: list, register, get or delete one, and its actions authinfo, autorenew, status, reachability, createstatus, renew, restore and transferout.
entity_desc.domain_availability: Whether a domain name is available, with its products, prices and taxes.
entity_desc.domain_change_owner: A change of a domain's owner: start it, follow it, or resend its emails (`foa`).
entity_desc.domain_claim: Trademark claims on a domain name: get them, or accept them.
entity_desc.domain_contact: A domain's contacts: get or update them, or change its owner (`owner`).
entity_desc.domain_dnskey: A domain's DNSSEC keys at the registry: list, add or delete one, or replace them all (update).
entity_desc.domain_dnssec: DNSSEC for a domain on LiveDNS: get its status, turn it on or turn it off.
entity_desc.domain_host: A domain's glue records, by host name: list, create, get, update or delete one.
entity_desc.domain_livedns: A domain's LiveDNS status, and switching the domain to LiveDNS (create).
entity_desc.domain_nameserver: A domain's nameservers: list them or replace them.
entity_desc.domain_tag: A domain's tags: list, add, replace, change or remove them.
entity_desc.domain_transfer: A transfer of a domain to Gandi: start it, follow it, relaunch it, update its authorization code (`authinfo`), check it is possible (`available`) or resend its emails (`foa`).
entity_desc.domain_webredir: A domain's web redirections, by host: list, create, get, update or delete one.
entity_desc.email_forward: A forwarding address in the deprecated Email API, per domain: list, create, update or delete one.
entity_desc.email_mailbox: A mailbox in the deprecated Email API, per domain: list, create, get, update or delete one, purge it (`purge`), renew it (`renew`) or renew them all (`renew_all`).
entity_desc.email_migration: A domain's migration from the Email API to Mailbox: get its details or start it.
entity_desc.email_offer: A domain's email offer in the deprecated Email API: get or update it.
entity_desc.email_slot: A mailbox slot in the deprecated Email API, per domain: list, create, get or refund one.
entity_desc.hosting_application: The applications Web Hosting can run: list them or get one.
entity_desc.hosting_instance: A Web Hosting instance: list, create, get, update or delete one, act on it (`action`) or get its usage (`usage`).
entity_desc.hosting_vhost: A Web Hosting instance's virtual hosts, by fqdn: list, create, get, update or delete one, or purge its cache (`cache`).
entity_desc.issued_certificate: An SSL certificate: list, order, get, update or revoke one, retrieve it as PEM (`crt`), or get DCV parameters (`dcv_params`).
entity_desc.linked_zone: A linked zone: list, create, get, update or delete one.
entity_desc.linked_zone_deployment: Deploy or undeploy a linked zone.
entity_desc.linked_zone_domain: The domains using linked zones: list them, get one, link domains to a zone (`link`) or unlink them (`unlink`).
entity_desc.linked_zone_task: Linked zone tasks: list them or get one.
entity_desc.livedns_axfr_slave: A zone's secondary servers, by IP address: list, add or remove one.
entity_desc.livedns_axfr_tsig: The TSIG keys a zone uses for transfers: list them, associate one or remove one.
entity_desc.livedns_domain: A domain on LiveDNS, by fqdn: list, add, get or update one.
entity_desc.livedns_key: A zone's DNSSEC keys on LiveDNS: list, create, get, undelete (update) or delete one.
entity_desc.livedns_nameserver: A zone's nameservers, or the generic nameservers LiveDNS would give it (`generic`).
entity_desc.livedns_record: A DNS record set, by fqdn, rrset_name and rrset_type: list, create, get, replace, update or delete one; every record of one name (`name`); or a verification record (`verification`).
entity_desc.livedns_rrtype: The DNS record types LiveDNS supports.
entity_desc.livedns_snapshot: A zone's snapshots: list, take, get, rename or delete one.
entity_desc.livedns_tsig_key: A TSIG key for zone transfers: list, create or get one, or its configuration for a DNS server (`config`).
entity_desc.livedns_zone: A zone's whole record set, by fqdn: replace every record (update) or delete every record (remove).
entity_desc.mailbox: A mailbox, by address: list, create, get, update or delete one, or renew it (`renew`).
entity_desc.mailbox_domain: The domains used for mail: list them, get one's DNS configuration, or check it (`validate`).
entity_desc.mailbox_forward: A forwarding address: list, create, update or delete one.
entity_desc.mailbox_product: The mailbox products on offer, and buying one (create).
entity_desc.mailbox_quota: Mailboxes available and in use, per offer.
entity_desc.mailbox_slot: A mailbox slot: list them or get one.
entity_desc.organization: An organization: list, create, get, update or delete one.
entity_desc.organization_customer: An organization's customers: list, create, get, update or delete one.
entity_desc.template: A configuration template: list, create, get, update or delete one.
entity_desc.template_dispatch: Applying a template (create), and the dispatch that results.
entity_desc.tld: The top-level domains on offer: list them or get one.
entity_desc.user: The user the token belongs to.
